title: Customer Service (Jev + LLM)
description: Tell us what you need and we'll route you to the right team.

customizations.welcomeMessage: Hi there! How can I help you today?

displayedMessages.shows: LLM-written situational reply (Claude Sonnet 5.5) based on the customer's message, the Route by Category branch and Jev's category/sentiment/shoe_scope scores, with 20-message conversation memory; apologises and flags priority for angry customers
Only when Write Reply fails: generic 'a member of our customer service team will be in contact shortly' reply, prefixed with an apology for angry or irritated customers
